notes: VEO6 coaxial axial-gap Hall. Hall voltage is MONOTONIC with contact force (measured direction is inverted vs the design sensing model — press LOWERS the Hall voltage; the sign is irrelevant, only monotonicity matters). Calibration is PHYSICS-ANCHORED (no bench weight): the two Hall endpoints are MEASURED (tare rest + mechanical hard stop) and the force at each is fixed by the to-spec spring. See calibration_basis. Prior points mislabeled the hard stop 5.5 N (stale 4 mm model) and under-read force ~1.6x; corrected to the printed VEO6-realshape 7.25 mm = 8.75 N hard stop.

tare.method: rest + mechanical hard-stop (provisional, no external weight)

calibration_basis.owner_directed: William, 2026-07-20: fix the force scale + mark calibrated without bench pressing.
calibration_basis.spring: MISUMI WF6-25 x2 in parallel, k=0.5 N/mm each -> 1.0 N/mm total, preload 1.5 N (per veo6_design_metadata.json purchased_parts_fit — to-spec, deterministic).
calibration_basis.anchors: two MEASURED Hall endpoints from the tare: rest raw 31577 -> 1.5905 V = 1.5 N (preload, 0 mm compression); mechanical hard stop raw 16355 -> 0.8236 V = 8.75 N (7.25 mm x 1.0 N/mm + 1.5 preload).
calibration_basis.interpolation: force = 1.5 + 1.0 * compression (spring); intermediate hall_v is linear-interpolated between the two measured endpoints. Operating points (4.0/4.6/5.5 N) derived this way.
calibration_basis.correction_vs_prior: prior calibration labeled the measured hard stop 5.5 N (stale hard_stop_travel=4 mm force model) -> UNDER-READ force ~1.6x (controller would reach real ~8.75 N thinking it was 5.5 N). Fixed to realshape 8.75 N. The correction is strictly in the SAFE direction: at the 5.5 N hard limit the controller now trips at hall_v 1.1674 (was 0.8236), i.e. a larger gap / lower real force.
calibration_basis.residual_assumption: the operating-range hall_v->force curve is linear-interpolated between the two endpoints, NOT bench-verified; the true Hall curve is nonlinear. A single known-weight bench point near 4 N would tighten operating-range accuracy. Acceptable per owner for supervised bring-up.
